notFound: cafeappliances.com and haierappliances.com answered every request, including one through WebFetch, with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403), so Café and Haier prices were read from retailer pages (Abt listing pages and Town Appliance's own storefront product feed) instead of the makers' own pages.

AJ Madison (access denied), Lowe's (403) and Best Buy (connection dropped) refused every request, and Home Depot's listing pages showed no prices in the page itself (its Haier washers page held no product list at all), so none of the four supplied a price.

Haier laundry could not be confirmed as current: Abt's pages for QFW150SSNWW and HLC1700AXW both say the item is no longer available, Town Appliance marks QFD15ESSNWW and QFT15ESSNWW unavailable, and its one live QFW150SSNWW listing ($1,335.56, no regular price shown) disagrees with Abt, so no Haier washer, dryer or washer-dryer is in the file.
Haier portable washers such as HLPW028BXW and HLP21N turned up in search results, but no retailer listing page I could read showed them with a price, so they are left out.

Haier's 24-inch dishwashers QDP555SBNTS and QDP555SYNFS are marked unavailable by Town Appliance and are not on Abt's Haier dishwasher listing, so QDT125SSLSS is the only Haier dishwasher in the file.
No Café washer or dryer turned up: Abt's Café pages and the two pages of Café products in Town Appliance's feed list no laundry item.
Café CDT805, CDT845 and CDT875 series dishwashers (for example CDT845P4NW2 and CDT875P2NS1) are marked unavailable by Town Appliance and are not on Abt's current Café listing, so they are left out.
Abt shows 'Your Price' under a higher 'Comp. Value' that its page markup labels Regular Price; the Comp. Value is recorded for Abt offers, so Abt's own lower selling price is not in the file.
Town Appliance shows a lower price beside a higher compare-at price; the compare-at price is recorded for its offers, so its lower selling price is not in the file.

Where geappliances.com shows a lower selling price beside a 'Was' price (the msrp field in its listing data), the 'Was' price is recorded for GE and GE Profile models, so the lower selling prices are not in the file.

geappliances.com states no model year, so year holds the year of the site's product_first_distribution_date (when the model first shipped); it is null for Hotpoint, Café and Haier, whose pages state none.

geappliances.com's listing data also holds models flagged 'disabled' (for example the GE Profile front loader PFW950SPTDS and the GE top loader GTW538ASWWS) and V-prefixed commercial washers; they are left out because the site does not offer them for sale or they are not household machines.
GE's 'Stacked Washer Dryer Units' category (9 available listings on geappliances.com) was not collected, because the brief skips stacked washer and dryer units sold as one listing.
geappliances.com's listing data gives no place-settings count for GE and GE Profile dishwashers, so placeSettings is null for them.
UDT165SIVII is listed as a GE 18-inch panel-ready dishwasher on geappliances.com and as Café (and as Haier) at Town Appliance; it is kept once, as GE, from the maker's own page.
HDF310PGRWW and HDF310PGRBB are not on Hotpoint's current listing, which shows the HDF310PGZ pair; they are in the file only because Town Appliance lists them in stock at a $409 regular price.

geappliances.com's category pages fill their product grid from a search feed, so GE and GE Profile models, prices and specs were read from that feed (the site's own listing data), and how the page labels its 'Was' and selling prices was checked on one product page (PFW870SPVRS) rather than on every product page.

HDF330PGZWW and HDF330PGZBB appear in GE's site search with Hotpoint spec pages, but they are not on Hotpoint's current dishwasher listing or at Town Appliance, so no price was read and they are left out.
Hotpoint widthIn is null for the washer, the dryers and the HDF310PGZ dishwashers, and colour is null for the HDF310PGZ pair, because the pages read state neither.
